turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a famous ridge walk my friends want to do, but I'm scared of heights.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a real concern. Do you know how narrow it gets? Some ridges look scary in photos but feel wide when you're on them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My friend said there's one bit with drops on both sides.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's usually the hardest part for people with a fear of heights. Is there a bypass path around it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Worth checking a guidebook or a walking forum. Many ridges have a lower path for exactly that reason.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Try a smaller ridge first to see how you feel. And it's fine to turn back. Nobody good will mind.
